about: Abbreviations school records hold (the federal school files: 'Shamokin Area El Sch', 'Northwestern MS') and the words people write for them. Read by schoolNameWords (src/english/school-names.ts) where a school's name is shown. Each key is a whole word, matched in any case and never before a period; 'onlyBeforeSchoolOrLast' words are expanded only before School or at the end of a name ('El' also begins place names: 'El Paso'); 'onlyBeforeHigh' words only before High ('Lincoln Jr High' is a junior high; 'Martin Luther King Jr Elementary' keeps the Jr of the person's name).
